title: North Valley Gymnastics Society

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: At North Valley Gymnastics, we provide a fun and memorable birthday experience for children of all ages. Our NCCP-trained and certified coaches create an exciting, playful atmosphere with gymnastics circuit activities, games and open play, while adults relax and enjoy the fun from the comfort of our mezzanine. After the action-packed gymnastics session, you'll have access to our private party room to continue the celebration. Guests are welcome to bring their own food, birthday cake, and decorations. 11-15 participants: an additional $35. 16-20 participants: an additional $20.00 on top of the $35. Standard rate includes up to 10 participants. Sunday Birthday Parties have a 10-participant
